name: Termux Fleet Publisher
description: Fleet publisher for timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo: branch pushes, pull-request creation and merges on an ephemeral GitHub App installation token — its own rate-limit bucket, separate from the owner PAT bucket, so publishes and merges never die on the shared PAT wall. Write class: contents + pull_requests. Part of the fleet AppID specialist bundle (docs/ops/GITHUB-APP-PILOT.md).
